# MerkadAgency

> MerkadAgency helps vehicle wrap shops get found locally and turn quote requests into followed-up leads.

Email Camilo Reyna: camiloreyna@merkadagency.com
Address: 10601 N Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 78753

## Public pages

- [Home](https://merkadagency.com/)
- [Marketing for wrap shops](https://merkadagency.com/services/marketing-for-wrap-shops): Portfolio websites, quote questions, local SEO and AEO, Google Business Profile, and quote follow-up. Websites start at $500.
- [Wrap-shop CRM](https://merkadagency.com/services/wrap-shop-crm): Website lead and quote intake, contacts, sales pipeline, quotes, and email through the shop's Resend account. CRM license is $1,500 setup + $800/month.
- [Phantom Wraps & Coatings](https://merkadagency.com/work/phantom-wraps): The website and CRM used at Camilo Reyna's own Austin wrap shop.
- [Website development](https://merkadagency.com/services/website-development): Website-only projects and redesigns.
- [Website brief](https://merkadagency.com/resources/website-brief)
